display.title: Episode 219: The Golden Cup of Eliyahu HaNavi (Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan)
display.summary_short: Before Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan: why children are at the center of Pesach, two brothers say the Shema, and a poor woman who would not sell her cup of Eliyahu HaNavi is rewarded with a miracle.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shabbos Mevarchim for Nissan. Uncle Yossi explains that children stand at the heart of Pesach: Pharaoh's decree targeted Jewish children, whom Hashem protected, and the whole Seder, from the Mah Nishtanah to dipping the karpas, is built to get children to ask questions, which parents and teachers answer from the Torah, all with joy. After the Hakochainik march, two young brothers share the Shema, and a sponsor message follows. Story time opens with belief in Moshiach and the custom of the Kos shel Eliyahu. Devorah treasures a golden cup of Eliyahu HaNavi handed down in her family; before Pesach her struggling husband Beryl wants to sell it, but she refuses and trusts in Hashem. She shelters an old beggar from a storm, and he leaves her a gold coin that keeps reappearing on her table after every purchase. On Seder night the guest returns and reveals that he is Eliyahu HaNavi. The show ends by reading names of 'My Sefer Torah' contest entrants and new Tzivos Hashem members.
display.lesson: Honor the mitzvos and trust in Hashem even when times are hard; kindness to a stranger brings blessing.
